title: Check your sign-in details
body: Enter your email and password to sign in.
annotation: Editable UI design. Google and email are both supported. Prototype navigation previews the next step; native validation, account creation, consent and profile completion must be enforced before dashboard access. No real account operation occurs in Figma. First-time registration only. Completed returning accounts skip registration and profile collection. Passwords remain transient and masked; reopening a valid session routes directly to the dashboard. Canonical metadata mirrors auth/sign-in-error; email/password self-registration is permitted. Forgot password resolves to the existing GoServe 2.3 auth/reset-email screen, not an older assigned-account flow. On actual sign-in failure preserve the email, keep the password masked, and do not disclose whether the account exists.

body: Your student profile is required before you enter GoServe.

sections.text: Add your name, student ID, academic details, mobile number and gender.

annotation: Editable UI design. Google and email are both supported. Prototype navigation previews the next step; native validation, account creation, consent and profile completion must be enforced before dashboard access. No real account operation occurs in Figma. First-time registration only. Completed returning accounts skip registration and profile collection. Passwords remain transient and masked; reopening a valid session routes directly to the dashboard. Canonical metadata mirrors auth/profile-required. Complete profile resumes the existing student/consent frame, now the combined student-details form. This state is a missing-profile guard, not an email-domain restriction; completed returning accounts bypass onboarding.

sections.text: Choosing a payment method does not confirm payment or complete this request.

annotation: Required-fee contextual receipt, separate from the Free G04.7 receipt. The primary action opens only an existing payment-choice design preview; it creates no payment or charge and leaves provider actions disabled. Runtime may show this receipt/handoff only after submission, authoritative fee configuration, amount and ownership are verified; if an amount is unavailable, retain the blocked configuration state instead. Replace unloaded em dashes with actual server data, never a client-supplied amount. Keep request progress separate from payment. Connect from a required-fee confirmed-submission review fixture only; no automatic busy-to-success transition, invented fee or fabricated reference.
